title: Data Scientist
description:
**Location:** India (IND)  

**Work Mode:** Remote  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years

**Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for a **Data Scientist with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience** to work on data science projects with a strong focus on **forecasting and predictive modeling**. The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in **Python**, software development best practices, and building reliable and maintainable data science solutions. Experience with Azure\-based data and machine learning platforms will be an added advantage.

**1\. Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain **data science solutions with a focus on forecasting use cases**.
* Analyze datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights relevant to business requirements.
* Build, evaluate, and improve **forecasting and predictive models**.
* Prepare and transform data required for model development and analysis.
* Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Ensure developed solutions are reliable, maintainable, and suitable for deployment.
* Monitor model performance and support continuous improvement of existing forecasting solutions.
* Document models, methodologies, assumptions, and project outcomes.

**2\. Must\-Have Skills**
-------------------------

* **3–5 years of relevant hands\-on experience in Data Science.**
* **Strong hands\-on experience with Python** for data science and model development.
* **Hands\-on experience with forecasting and predictive modeling techniques.**
* **Hands\-on experience with Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Modularization.**
* **Hands\-on experience with Git and Version Control** practices.
* **Hands\-on experience with Unit Testing.**
* Practical experience with **CI/CD pipelines** and software development practices.
* Good level of **written and spoken English**.

**3\. Good\-to\-Have Skills**
-----------------------------

* Experience with **Azure Databricks**.
* Experience with **Azure Machine Learning**, particularly **Jobs and Pipelines**.
* Knowledge of **YAML configurations**.
* Hands\-on experience with **PySpark**.
* Familiarity with **Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar task management tools**.

**Job Description**

**Migration \& Development**

  

* Migrate and rebuild the highest\-complexity automation use cases from Automation Anywhere to Python on the Convergence platform.
* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate development, then critically review, test, and harden generated code so it behaves identically to the original.
* Build new automations and shared libraries that raise the productivity of the whole squad.
* Decompose legacy bots into clear specifications and reusable patterns that others can follow.

 **Quality \& Code Review**

* Review code from T1 engineers and enforce CARS coding, testing, and audit standards before changes are merged.
* Design and implement automated test coverage that proves equivalence between migrated and legacy automations, including edge cases.
* Produce and maintain the test evidence required to meet ITGC audit standards.
* Catch subtly wrong AI\-generated output that a junior engineer may miss, and coach the team on how to spot it and improve automated standards to prevent recurrence.

 **Support \& Operations**

* Resolve complex production issues escalations and keep critical automations running.
* Improve monitoring, logging, and resilience of automations on the Convergence platform.

 **Collaboration \& Mentoring**

* Mentor engineers and pair with them on complex or audit\-sensitive work.
* Contribute to squad ceremonies, code reviews, and continuous improvement of the CARS development framework.
* Document automations, patterns, and decisions to support handoff, scalability, and audit.

  

Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Required:**

* 4\+ years of professional software engineering with strong, production\-grade Python
* Working knowledge of object\-oriented programming
* Proven track record migrating, refactoring, or rebuilding complex codebases
* Strong testing discipline and the ability to prove that code behaves correctly
* Skill at reading, reviewing, and repairing code written by others, including AI\-generated code
* Hands\-on experience running software in production, including monitoring, incident response, and operational support
* Familiarity and comfort with SQL
* Solid experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD
* Strong problem\-solving skills and sound engineering judgment
* Fluent English (written and verbal) – required for global collaboration

 **Preferred:**

* Experience migrating RPA automations (Automation Anywhere, UiPath, or Blue Prism) to code
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude)
* Experience mentoring or leading junior engineers
* Cloud platform experience (Azure or GCP)
